newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on Tokyo sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on Tokyo sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended down on Tuesday on selling from traders on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM), bullion traders in Hong Kong said.
"We saw more liquidation of long positions from the Japanese traders," said one gold dealer.
Bullion ended at US$367.60/368.10 an ounce on Tuesday against New York's US$367.80/368.30 close on Monday.
But some bargain hunting emerged at $367.50 per ounce and the market held at that level, dealers said.
Bullion was expected to continue trading in a narrow range between $367.00 and $369.50, with some sources saying general weakness in the white metals also putting pressure on gold.
Local gold ended HK$3 lower at HK$3,398 a tael.
The carry over charge remained unchanged from its previous fix at -6.00
Hong Kong close - US$367.60/368.10 New York close - US$367.80/368.30
